news.title: The Fed releases its latest interest rate decision Wednesday. Here's what to expect
news.description: This week's meeting offers little suspense and probably not much action, even as massive changes loom over the Fed's longer-term direction.

news.title: Homebuyers are backing out of deals at the fastest pace in nearly a decade
news.description: More than 16% of signed contracts on homes in December were cancelled, as consumers face continued uncertainty in the economy and rising inventory.

news.title: The government is barreling toward a partial shutdown over DHS funding. Here's what to expect
news.description: The U.S. government may partially shutdown on Saturday months after a record 43-day closure in 2025.
